description: This file defines a service module for managing OpenAI vector stores, including functions to retrieve, list, create, update, delete, upload files to, and delete files from OpenAI vector stores, with credential management and error handling.

methods.name: getAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Retrieves a specific OpenAI vector store by ID using provided credentials.

methods.name: listAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Lists all OpenAI vector stores associated with the provided credentials.

methods.name: createAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Creates a new OpenAI vector store with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Updates an existing OpenAI vector store with new parameters and retrieves associated files.

methods.name: deleteAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Deletes a specified OpenAI vector store.

methods.name: uploadFilesToAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Uploads files to an OpenAI vector store, converting and batching them.

methods.name: deleteFilesFromAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Deletes specified files from an OpenAI vector store.
